labCollection.title: Consent for Laboratory Sample Collection and Testing
labCollection.bodyText: You are about to provide samples for laboratory testing. The laboratory will collect biological samples from you. These samples will be tested to help your doctor understand your health condition. The results will be shared with your ordering physician. Your samples will be handled according to medical standards and your information will be kept confidential.
labCollection.rightToRefuse: You have the right to refuse this procedure at any time. Refusing will not affect your right to receive other medical care.

flag.NO_FEMALE_FAMILY_PRESENT: Prefers no female family members present during collection

desc.MALE_PHLEBOTOMIST: Patient prefers blood draw by a male technician
desc.PRIVACY_SCREEN: Use a privacy screen during sample collection
desc.FASTING_CARE: Patient may be fasting — offer water and a date after collection
desc.NO_MALE_FAMILY_PRESENT: Male family members should not be present during female sample collection
desc.NO_FEMALE_FAMILY_PRESENT: Female family members should not be present during male sample collection

desc.GENDER_SEGREGATED_WAITING: Patient prefers a gender-segregated waiting area
desc.CUSTOM: A custom cultural preference not covered by the predefined options

principle.title: About AI Confidence Alerts
principle.body: This system is designed to alert more aggressively when less certain. High-confidence AI outputs appear subtle. Low-confidence outputs trigger prominent alerts and automatic escalation to a physician. This ensures uncertainty is never hidden.

notification.body: An AI output with low confidence requires physician review.

flow.title: Security Alert
flow.notManagerWarning: Only a Lab Manager can activate Security Alert.
flow.activateDescription: This will immediately restrict the device to read-only mode and begin emergency data protection.
flow.encryptDescription: Encrypting all patient data with a one-time key. Keep this key safe — it is the only way to recover data.
flow.keyExportDescription: Download this key to USB or photograph the QR code. Do NOT leave it on this device.
flow.qrInstructions: Photograph this key and store it separately from this device.
flow.backupDescription: Generate a device backup to restore from when conditions improve.
flow.checklistDescription: Complete the rapid shutdown checklist before leaving.
flow.doneDescription: All patient data is encrypted. Security Mode is active.
